rationale: The agent cancelled an order without first confirming the action with the user, violating the requirement to confirm every order-changing write. Authentication was insufficient (only an email lookup; no explicit user verification). The order ID was not provided by the user and there is no evidence it was validated as belonging to the user. The agent did not attempt or verify whether partial cancellation was possible before cancelling the entire order despite the user’s conditional instruction. Finally, the agent stated refund amount, payment method, and timeline without visible support from tool outputs. These issues breach the policy, so the conversation fails.
